note: Mile markers. First the world. Then whether THIS table's plan held. Not a forecast. Fill the household baseline before you receive a dispatch.

H-01.succeed: PLAN HELD. Out-of-area contact copied a short list. Papers were already in one bag. Second comms method worked once. No household on this net panic-bought the town. You still have cash and fuel for later miles.
H-01.mixed: PLAN PARTIAL. One house copied the out-of-area check. Another did not. Someone spent more than they meant to at the store. The group is not lost, but the next mile will be louder.
H-01.fail: PLAN DID NOT HOLD. No shared contact tree. No second radio. Two houses spent hard on rumor. Officials still have not ordered anyone to leave. You burned the easy hours.

H-02.succeed: PLAN HELD. Fuel and cash cap was named before anyone drove. Hosting rule was yes or no, not maybe. A relative got a clear answer. Roads still open. You did not spend the week's gallons on a maybe.
H-02.mixed: PLAN PARTIAL. One house moved. One stayed. Nobody wrote the gallon number until after the first tank. A spare room was promised and then argued. Distance is now a resource you are spending.
H-02.fail: PLAN DID NOT HOLD. No fallback route. No shelter rule. A drive started on rumor and stalled on price. Someone is between places with no check-in hour.

H-03.succeed: PLAN HELD. Cellular data is ugly. This net still copied because a second method was tested. Check-in hour was kept. Out-of-area relay confirmed three households. You know who is dark.
H-03.mixed: PLAN PARTIAL. One text got through four hours late. One house never copied. Weather radio worked; the group did not all listen at the same hour. Isolation has started.
H-03.fail: PLAN DID NOT HOLD. Apps failed and there was no tested fallback. This dispatch is late. Two callsigns are unaccounted. Untested comms are not comms.

H-04.succeed: PLAN HELD. A refill path was already named. Dependents and pets had a 14-day workaround that does not need the ER. Transport to a backup clinic was possible. Delay, not a battlefield, is the danger — and you planned for delay.
H-04.mixed: PLAN PARTIAL. One household had extra days of a refill. Another did not. A ride existed but was not written. The ER is busy with fear. You still have time if you close the medical gap this week.
H-04.fail: PLAN DID NOT HOLD. No refill plan. No dependent workaround. No second way to get there. A common bottle is already late. This is how a house fails first — not a bomb, a gap.

H-05.succeed: PLAN HELD. Water and food floors were named before anyone shared. Cards flaked; cash and a backup still worked. After helping a neighbor you still have days on the shelf. Mutual aid did not bankrupt the givers.
H-05.mixed: PLAN PARTIAL. One house shared past its floor. One hoarded and is now alone. Grocer is short. You can still reset the sharing rule tonight if you write the number.
H-05.fail: PLAN DID NOT HOLD. No water or food count. No payment backup. Sharing was all-or-nothing. A giver is now. A taker has no neighbor left. The restock lag is not over.

H-06.succeed: PLAN HELD. The viral clip is still unverified. This net used the short source list: local EM, weather, utility, Ready.gov, one out-of-area human. Shelter and papers were already decided. Nobody left the table to hunt a neighbor. Rent and medicine still come due — and you can pay or prove who you are.
H-06.mixed: PLAN PARTIAL. The table argued the video for too long. One house still has a 30-day roof plan. Another does not. Officials say ignore unverified clips. You did not hunt anyone. The bill is still the bill.
H-06.fail: PLAN DID NOT HOLD. The story split the group. No written shelter. No papers. Someone wanted to go looking for an enemy in town. HARD WALL: you still do not hunt people. You also do not have a 30-day plan. That is a fail on the family score, not a win in the war.
